item.title: Warudo Exporter v1.1.0
item.content:encoded:
• Added initial support for VRCFury.
  • Potentially fixed avatars exporting lying on the floor.
  • Potentially fixed package resolve button throwing errors in the installer.
  • Added link to this documentation in the tool header. Just click the little (?) in the inspector.
  • Fixed error when trying to export without an avatar descriptor.
  • Fixed error when trying to build a mod without the exporter script being on the avatar.
  • Fixed some other stuff I forgor 💀

Known Issues:​

  • A popup complaining about being unable to open a read only scene will popup every time you do something. For now, to fix this open Window > Package Manager and remove NDMF from the list of packages. Then, import NDMF through VRChat Creator Companion.

To update delete the Assets/Pumkin folder. If you already imported the Warudo SDK, also delete the Assets/Warudo, Assets/Warudo SDK and Assets/Packages folders. Then import the new Unity Package.

item.title: Warudo Exporter Released!
item.description: After about a month of hard work, Warudo Exporter 1.0 has finally released!
item.content:encoded:
After about a month of hard work, Warudo Exporter 1.0 has finally released!

I'll be supporting it for a while, as there's still a bunch of stuff to do, so stay tuned!

Check out the documentation for more info!
